description:
Convert your Mackenzie crib into a toddler bed with this rail kit. Designed for both slat-back and panel-back Mackenzie cribs, this conversion kit provides a comfortable next step.

Crafted from solid Brown Maple that blends seamlessly with your Mackenzie nursery furniture.
